description: Offline prerequisite inspection plus app-owned admission of an explicitly authorized closed local ACS package. A checksum-pinned 2024 ACS 5-year ZCTA network-acquisition plan and fail-closed four-group response/reconciliation validators are implemented, but network execution remains disabled pending explicit authorization.
redirect_policy: No network transport exists. URLs, hosts, redirects, acquisition, and download are outside this validator.
retry: No network retry exists. Invalid or incomplete packages fail closed; operators may submit a corrected offline package as a new managed operation.
checkpoint: Managed operations durably record state. Inputs are copied into operation-owned storage before validation; release staging is run-scoped and the manifest is written last.
idempotency: Pinned prerequisite SHA-256 values yield the same inspection. Each admitted release is content-bound together with its managed operation and invocation timestamp; no mutable pointer is written.
cancellation: Inspection and admission accept cooperative cancellation. Admission checks cancellation during bounded copy, row replay, staging, and before atomic publication; incomplete release staging is removed while operation-owned input remains available for inspection.
retention_profile: Inspection retains nothing. Offline admission retains the supplied authorization, official metadata, and data in an immutable local-review release; it creates no current pointer or production enrollment.
